source: The Scottish Book: independently curated mathematical questions, proofs, and research candidates

problems.title: Prime-spectrum saturation
problems.question: Does the maximum distinct-prime-sum deficit of a prime-sum perfect matching stay bounded?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Interior prime sums realized by a partial matching; completion is open in this study
problems.verification: Exact small matching optimization

rewards.condition: A proof of bounded prime-sum deficit, or an unbounded sequence of deficits.

problems.title: Prime-sum matching reconfiguration
problems.question: Are all prime-sum perfect matchings joined by four-cycle switches?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: One connected component through n=12 in exhaustive tests
problems.verification: Enumerated 423,884 matchings at n=12 in initial exploration

rewards.condition: A classification of four-cycle-switch components for all prime-sum perfect matchings.

problems.title: Edge-disjoint prime-sum matchings
problems.question: Is the maximum perfect-matching packing equal to the host graph's minimum degree?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Equivalent to a min-cut condition for an arithmetic bipartite factor
problems.verification: Integral max flow tested to n=3,000 (finite only)

rewards.condition: A proof of matching-packing equality for every order, or a counterexample.

problems.title: Sidon exchange connectivity
problems.question: Are size-k Sidon sets connected by feasible one-mark exchanges below the square-root scale?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Elementary connectivity theorem for N > 2(2k-1)^3
problems.verification: Small disconnected/connected cases enumerated

rewards.condition: An asymptotic determination of the connectivity threshold for one-mark Sidon exchanges.

problems.title: Coprime permutation switches
problems.question: Can all permutations satisfying gcd(i,σ(i))=1 be connected by valid two-position swaps?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: No universal-row/column shortcut; arithmetic structure is essential
problems.verification: 3,459,600 states at n=14, one component

rewards.condition: A necessary and sufficient criterion for connected coprime-permutation switch graphs.

problems.title: Sidon sets without prime differences
problems.question: What is the asymptotic maximum size of a Sidon set whose positive differences avoid all primes?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Asymptotic lower constant at least 1/√2 and upper at most 1
problems.verification: Small exact MILP optima through N=60

rewards.condition: The sharp leading constant in the maximum size of a prime-difference-free Sidon set.

problems.title: Coprime path difference spectrum
problems.question: Can a coprime Hamiltonian path attain the parity upper bound for distinct adjacent differences?
problems.novelty: known subproblem; extension unverified
problems.result: Full graceful existence iff n≤5 is a published 2021 theorem; extremal extension unverified
problems.verification: Exact finite MILP checks in selected sizes

rewards.condition: A proof or disproof of eventual attainment of the parity upper bound for coprime paths.

problems.title: Arithmetic centering of coprime percolation
problems.question: Can the critical connectivity center be approximated by a specified non-tautological arithmetic expansion?
problems.novelty: needs precise formulation
problems.result: Internal threshold/Gumbel arguments require external proof and priority audit
problems.verification: Finite degree-profile and center checks

rewards.condition: A specified non-tautological expansion of the arithmetic connectivity threshold with a proved error term.

problems.title: Two-prime palette pairings
problems.question: Can 1,…,2n always be paired using at most two distinct prime sums?
problems.novelty: high overlap: Maillet-type prime differences and OEIS A202472; distinct pairing statement not shown equivalent
problems.result: One-color iff 2n+1 prime; two-color certificate from short prime difference
problems.verification: Sieve certificates through n=1,000,000 (finite only)
problems.priority: reframe: isolate a two-palette theorem independent of the classical prime-difference certificate

rewards.condition: A proof that two prime sums suffice for every positive integer n, or an explicit counterexample.

problems.title: Minimum coprime adjacencies
problems.question: What is the exact minimum number of adjacent coprime pairs in a permutation of 1,…,n? (Resolved internally.)
problems.novelty: internal proof; priority unverified
problems.result: Exact path-cover formula and asymptotic proved in the repository; manuscript submitted to Integers
problems.verification: Constructive proof with prime-factor paths; explicit witnesses checked n≤10,000

rewards.condition: An independently checked Lean formalization of the exact coprime-adjacency theorem.

problems.title: Random sum-diagonal matching transitions
problems.question: In random sum-diagonal bipartite graphs, how do perfect matchings and min-degree factor saturation emerge?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Random sum-graphs are known; matching and factor phase behavior not located; factor saturation not monotone
problems.verification: Explicit three-by-three obstruction to monotonicity; no asymptotic claims

sources.name: Balachandran–Kush (2021), matching in random bipartite graphs

rewards.condition: A rigorous threshold law for perfect matchings in the random sum-diagonal graph model.

problems.title: Coprime matching-space percolation
problems.question: At what densities do the perfect matchings of a thinned coprime graph form one four-cycle reconfiguration component?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Connects P005 matching switches to P008 arithmetic thinning; phase diagram not yet determined
problems.verification: Frozen-edge obstruction identified; unique-matching and nonmonotonicity caveats

rewards.condition: A sharp connectivity threshold for the four-cycle reconfiguration graph under arithmetic thinning.

problems.title: Random-site Sidon exchange geometry
problems.question: Can Sidon-set existence and feasible one-element-exchange connectivity have different transition regimes inside a random subset of [N]?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Random Sidon decision phase behavior is known; feasible exchange components form a distinct proposed observable
problems.verification: k=2 degenerate connectivity checked conceptually; no large-case claim

rewards.condition: A sequence of site probabilities where Sidon configurations exist with high probability but the exchange graph is disconnected with high probability.

problems.title: Homology of random Cayley sum flag complexes
problems.question: Do clique complexes of random Cayley sum graphs over cyclic prime groups have the same homology-vanishing exponents as Erdős–Rényi flag complexes?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Exact triangle expectation matches Erdős–Rényi; four-clique expectation has an additive-parallelogram correction
problems.verification: Exact enumeration of K4 motif moments for odd cyclic orders 5, 7, 9

sources.name: Kahle (2009), topology of random clique complexes

rewards.condition: A proof or disproof that the specified Cayley-sum flag-complex homology thresholds match the independent-edge model.

problems.title: Odd-area lattice triangulation flip connectivity
problems.question: Are all odd-normalized-area triangulations of a convex lattice polygon connected by odd-area-preserving diagonal flips when all four mod-2 vertex residues occur?
problems.novelty: high overlap risk: colored triangulation flip graphs
problems.result: Odd doubled area iff the triangle has three different mod-2 vertex classes; flips require all four classes
problems.verification: Exhaustive parity color patterns through n=9 (zero disconnected four-class cases); six-vertex three-color obstruction

sources.name: Baur et al., coloured triangulation flip graphs (2025)

rewards.condition: A general proof of four-class odd-area flip connectivity, or a finite counterexample.

problems.title: Topology of the Sidon simplicial complex
problems.question: Does each fixed-dimensional reduced homology group of the simplicial complex of all Sidon subsets of [N] vanish for all sufficiently large N?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Minimal nonfaces have size 3 or 4; exact F2 Betti numbers exhibit migration from lower to higher dimensions
problems.verification: Exact augmented boundary-rank computations through N=23; no asymptotic vanishing claim

sources.name: Superdock (2023), Sidon sets and simplicial configurations

rewards.condition: A proof of eventual vanishing for each fixed homological degree, or an infinite nonvanishing family.

problems.title: Random divisibility-poset chain height
problems.question: Does the longest divisibility chain in a Bernoulli random subset of [N] have a deterministic limiting length after division by log₂ N?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: For fixed 0<p<1, the normalized height is asymptotically between p and 1 in probability; convergence to a constant is unproved
problems.verification: Exact dynamic program cross-checked against all subsets for N≤9; exploratory sampling at larger N

sources.name: Lewis–Souza (2021), dimension of the divisibility order

rewards.condition: Existence or nonexistence of the normalized longest-chain limit for a fixed site density strictly between zero and one.

problems.title: Conserved-XOR basis exchange fibers
problems.question: What exchange size is necessary to connect vector-space bases with a fixed XOR total, and how does connectivity change under random deletion of available vectors?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Single-element moves cannot preserve XOR; two-exchange fibers are connected for all W at d=4 but can be disconnected at d=5
problems.verification: All 32,768 available sets at d=4 checked, plus explicit ten-vector d=5 counterexample with components 4 and 2

sources.name: Reconfiguration of basis pairs in regular matroids (2026)

rewards.condition: The least uniform exchange size connecting every feasible conserved-XOR basis fiber.

problems.title: Exchange complexity of optimal no-three-in-line configurations
problems.question: Does a universal bound exist on the number of points that must be simultaneously replaced to connect all maximum-size no-three-in-line subsets of an n×n grid?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: When the maximum size is 2n, single-point exchanges are impossible and two-point exchanges are rectangle switches
problems.verification: Exact optimal configuration exchange graphs through n=7; minimal connecting move sizes 2,4,3,5,6 for n=3,...,7
problems.priority: exploratory — exchange rigidity and finite optimal configurations

rewards.condition: A universal bound on simultaneous replacements in optimal no-three-in-line configurations, or a proof of unboundedness.

problems.title: Cokernel laws of random p-adic Hankel matrices
problems.question: Does the cokernel of an n×n Haar-random p-adic Hankel matrix converge in distribution to a describable measure on finite abelian p-groups?
problems.novelty: not certified; targeted literature comparison only
problems.result: Classical Hankel corank and exact cyclic/two-generator/elementary-abelian laws; uniform positive TV separation from ordinary Cohen–Lenstra law; full limit unresolved
problems.verification: Exact modular group counts at p=2 (n≤4), p=3 (n≤3); kernel-product rank proved from Yiasemides (2024)

sources.name: Yiasemides (2024), characteristic polynomials and Hankel kernels

rewards.condition: An explicit limiting distribution for random p-adic Hankel cokernels, or a proof that it does not exist.
An exact probability for a previously untreated three-generator higher-exponent cokernel class.

problems.title: Random Cayley-sum sandpile groups
problems.question: Does the Sylow-ell sandpile group of a random prime-cyclic Cayley-sum graph converge to a law different from Erdős–Rényi?
problems.novelty: not certified (targeted audit)
problems.result: Precisely defined correlated graph-Laplacian cokernel; no limiting group law yet proved
problems.verification: Model and connectivity-conditioning requirements specified; exact Smith-form experiments pending

sources.name: Wood (2017), sandpile groups of random graphs

rewards.condition: An explicit limiting Sylow-group distribution for the correlated Cayley-sum sandpile model.

problems.title: Random unimodular triangle complex homology
problems.question: What are homology regimes for random lattice-site complexes whose two-faces have normalized area one?
problems.novelty: not certified (targeted audit)
problems.result: At N=1 with all four vertices kept the complex is the tetrahedral boundary, with reduced H2 nonzero
problems.verification: Exact elementary N=1 example only; finite Betti experiments pending

rewards.condition: A proved nontrivial homology transition regime for the random unimodular triangle complex.

problems.title: Rank of random prime-divisibility incidence matrices
problems.question: When do independently retained prime-incidence vectors of integers up to N span all small-prime coordinates over F2?
problems.novelty: not certified (targeted audit)
problems.result: Full rank iff no nonzero prime-parity functional annihilates all retained columns; exact zero-row probability
problems.verification: Deterministic parity characterization proved; probabilistic threshold unproved

rewards.condition: A sharp threshold for full rank of the random prime-incidence matrix.

problems.title: Zero forcing on the divisor comparability graph
problems.question: What is the asymptotic zero-forcing number of the divisibility comparability graph on integers 1,...,N?
problems.novelty: not certified (targeted audit)
problems.result: The primes above N/2 are twin leaves, yielding Z(D_N) >= pi(N)-pi(N/2)-1
problems.verification: Elementary rigorous lower bound; exact finite zero-forcing computations pending

rewards.condition: The first-order asymptotics of the zero-forcing number of the divisor comparability graph.

problems.title: Cyclic lcm Hamiltonian bottleneck
problems.question: Does closing the permutation into a cycle preserve the known N²/(4 log N) minimum adjacent-lcm bottleneck asymptotic?
problems.novelty: confirmed collision for linear-path analogue
problems.result: Erdős–Freud–Hegyvári (1983) already prove the linear-path asymptotic; cyclic-only variation remains under review
problems.verification: Elementary lower bound recovered; no independent cyclic upper bound

rewards.condition: A proof or disproof of the cyclic analogue of the known adjacent-lcm bottleneck asymptotic.

problems.title: Four-cycle generation in prime-sum bipartite graphs
problems.question: Do the four-cycles of the bipartite prime-sum graph generate its entire binary cycle space for every n, and how efficiently can its cycles be filled by squares?
problems.novelty: not certified (specialist source check needed)
problems.result: Exact finite-field elimination gives vanishing square-filled first homology for n up to 60; no proof for all n
problems.verification: Exhaustive enumeration of all four-cycles and their GF(2) boundary span; reproducible standard-library code
problems.priority: new candidate; arithmetic topology / toric overlap risk

sources.name: Prime Sum Graphs and the Induced Trees They Contain (2025)

rewards.condition: A proof that prime-sum four-cycles span the binary cycle space in all orders, or a counterexample.

problems.title: Mixing of maximum primitive-set exchanges
problems.question: Determine the mixing-time order and possible cutoff for single-chain heat-bath dynamics on maximum primitive subsets of [2n].
problems.novelty: not certified; closely related to counting primitive sets and distributive-lattice walks
problems.result: Exact exchange diameter and isolated 23-state factors; certified full mixing lower bound (121926/66083)n log n−O(n) and 23-adic divisibility; full mixing unresolved
problems.verification: Exact 23-state enumeration; improved rational Rayleigh 66083/243852 (older 101/363); five-block isolation proved and finitely checked
problems.priority: theorem-building — improved sharp-scale lower obstruction; full interacting-core mixing upper bound and historical novelty remain open

sources.name: Heat-bath random walks with Markov bases (2018)
Propp (1997), Generating Random Elements of Finite Distributive Lattices

rewards.condition: A classification of irreducible components and a sharp mixing-time estimate on a specified nontrivial component.

problems.title: Möbius deformation from random divisibility complexes
problems.question: What are the asymptotic mean and fluctuations of the Euler characteristic of Bernoulli-thinned integer divisibility order complexes?
problems.novelty: not certified; arithmetic Dirichlet convolution and order-complex Möbius theory are classical
problems.result: Internally derived exact Euler-characteristic expectation with Dirichlet series p(zeta−1)/(1+p(zeta−1)); p=1 recovers the Mertens function
problems.verification: Exact enumerative small-N checks and independent coefficient recurrence
problems.priority: promising; analytic number theory and random topology

sources.name: Nontrivial divisor functions and ordered factorizations

rewards.condition: A nondegenerate fluctuation law for the random Euler characteristic after explicit centering and scaling.

problems.title: Prime-supported permutation X-ray fiber reconfiguration
problems.question: Is there a universal bounded-size exchange connecting every fiber of prime-sum permutations with the same anti-diagonal X-ray?
problems.novelty: known exact anti-diagonal X-ray invariant; novelty of prime-restricted bounded Markov moves unverified
problems.result: No two-position swap can preserve a nontrivial exact sum multiset; an explicit prime-supported fiber with two members differs at four positions
problems.verification: Exhaustive prime-sum matching fiber enumeration for n≤13; dependency-free script
problems.priority: reframe: compare applicable toric Markov bases to the restricted prime-supported fibers

rewards.condition: A universal bounded-size exchange theorem for nontrivial prime-sum X-ray fibers, or counterexamples with unbounded exchange size.

problems.title: Double-prime perfect matchings on integer intervals
problems.question: Does a perfect matching exist for every even n≥8 in the graph of integer pairs whose sum and absolute difference are both prime?
problems.novelty: not certified; prime sum/difference cycles have explicit earlier study
problems.result: Every odd n is impossible by parity; exact finite matchings exist for every even n in [8,400], while n=2,4,6 fail
problems.verification: Dependency-free exact bipartite matching checker for every even n≤400 and parity obstruction
problems.priority: promising; arithmetic Hall obstruction with direct Hamiltonicity predecessor

sources.name: Prime Sum Graphs and the Induced Trees They Contain (2025)

rewards.condition: A perfect double-prime matching for every even order at least eight, or an exceptional order.

problems.title: How large can a pairwise-coprime Sidon set be?
problems.question: Can [N] contain a pairwise-coprime Sidon set of size (1−o(1))sqrt(N)?
problems.novelty: not certified; Sidon sets of primes and additive-multiplicative restrictions require a specialist search
problems.result: Classical Sidon bound gives upper (1+o(1))sqrt(N); Sidon-subsets-of-primes results give a lower bound of order sqrt(N/log N)
problems.verification: Exact strong-Sidon and pairwise gcd enumeration for N≤30
problems.priority: promising; seek the sharp constant or a fixed multiplicative density loss

sources.name: Bailleul–Riblet, Sidon subsets of arbitrary integer sets (2026)
Sidon set classical bounds and constructions

rewards.condition: A sharp asymptotic for the maximum size of a pairwise-coprime Sidon subset of an initial interval.

problems.title: Is the prime-sum bipartite diameter eventually seven?
problems.question: Does the bipartite graph on two copies of [n], joined when i+j is prime, have diameter exactly seven for all sufficiently large n?
problems.novelty: strong overlap: bounded prime differences and Erdős Problem 17; exact quantifiers not equivalent
problems.result: Only prime-sum-two edge is a bridge; diameter seven is equivalent to uniformly finding prime pairs with prescribed even differences in bounded intervals
problems.verification: Exact bridge-based diameters for 2≤n≤250; independent all-pairs BFS for n≤35
problems.priority: reframe: establish a distinct theorem beyond bounded prime-difference coverage

sources.name: Croot–Jin, prime sum graphs and induced trees

rewards.condition: A proof of eventual diameter seven in prime-sum bipartite graphs, or infinitely many failures.

problems.title: Can three prime sums connect all integers?
problems.question: Can the graph on [n] be made connected using edges with only three distinct prime sums, for every n≥3?
problems.novelty: not certified; Chen–Fu–Guo (2021) established three-color Hamiltonian-prime-set phenomena for some orders, not this stated eventual connectivity theorem
problems.result: New quantified theorem: for any fixed 0<δ<1/5, asymptotically (3/4)C₂≈49.5121% of prime triples p<q<n<r in δ-relative intervals connect [n]. Sharper reflection criterion n≥5D; two colors characterized by twin primes; all-n remains unproved
problems.verification: Exact three-reflection sufficient condition tested on 77,795 artificial triples; prime-triple fractions checked through n=20,000; certified three-color witnesses for every 3≤n≤1,000,000 (existing n≤120 test and new n≥60 test)
problems.priority: theorem-building — quantitative prime palette density and million-case finite certification; still seek a uniform effective threshold or all-n constructive proof

sources.name: Chen–Fu–Guo, Hamiltonicity in Prime Sum Graphs
Prime sum Hamiltonian paths and twin-prime reflection constructions
Croot–Jin, Prime Sum Graphs and Induced Trees
Siegel–Walfisz theorem (Kedlaya, analytic number theory notes)
Montgomery–Vaughan Brun–Titchmarsh inequality for short intervals (cited in JTNB)

rewards.condition: A proof that three prime sums always connect the graph on an initial interval, or a counterexample.

problems.title: Four prime sums without cut vertices
problems.question: For every odd n≥7, do four distinct prime sums suffice to make the graph on [n] 2-vertex-connected?
problems.novelty: unverified; prime-sum connectivity predecessor
problems.result: For odd n≥5, at least four odd-prime labels are necessary for minimum degree two; the bound is attained in tested odd cases 7≤n≤39
problems.verification: Exhaustive four-label search for odd n=7,9,...,39; n=5 impossible even with all prime sums

sources.name: Chen–Fu–Guo (2021), Hamiltonicity in Prime Sum Graphs
Croot–Jin (2026), Prime Sum Graphs and the Induced Trees They Contain

rewards.condition: A construction using four prime sums for every odd order at least seven, or an exceptional order.

problems.title: Sidon coloring by divisibility antichains
problems.question: Can [N] be partitioned into (1+o(1))sqrt(N) sets, each Sidon and a divisibility antichain?
problems.novelty: high overlap risk: Sidon–Ramsey coloring and primitive sets
problems.result: (1-o(1))sqrt(N) <= chi_PS(N) <= (1+sqrt(2)+o(1))sqrt(N), using dyadic bands
problems.verification: Elementary proof from classical Sidon coloring; no finite exhaustive claim

rewards.condition: An asymptotically optimal Sidon and divisibility-antichain coloring, or a larger lower bound.

problems.title: When does a random Schur hypergraph acquire a 2-core?
problems.question: What is the threshold and critical law for a nonempty 2-core in the Schur-triple hypergraph induced by a random subset of [N]?

problems.title: Prime-gap deficit of induced cycles in the non-coprime graph
problems.question: What is the maximal growth order of 2π(sqrt(N)) minus the longest induced-cycle length in the gcd>1 graph, for N≤X?
problems.novelty: unverified; unboundedness follows from Pintz (2015), general threshold-cycle theory is classical

Pintz (2015), ratio of consecutive prime gaps, Theorem 1

problems.title: Additive complete mappings with almost distinct products
problems.question: For every prime p>=5, is there a permutation f of F_p such that x+f(x) permutes F_p and xf(x) has exactly p-2 distinct values?

problems.title: Sidon sets of primes under binary XOR
problems.question: Can the primes in every sufficiently large dyadic interval contain an XOR-Sidon subset of size at least a constant times the square root of the interval length?
problems.novelty: unverified; binary Sidon sets and APN functions are classical, prime-restricted extremal size needs comparison
problems.result: Internally proved 2^(m/2)/m << s_m <= 2^(m/2)+O(1) for primes in [2^m,2^(m+1))
problems.verification: Finite XOR Sidon/APN constructions and exhaustive translate-intersection checks for small m

problems.title: Full-dimensional simultaneous Sidon sets in a local field
problems.question: Does F_4[[T]] contain a compact perfect set of Hausdorff dimension one with no four distinct elements satisfying either a+b=c+d or ab=cd?
problems.novelty: unverified; close to Mycielski perfect-set fusion and quantitative pattern avoidance in local fields
problems.result: Explicit 1/2-Ahlfors-regular simultaneous Sidon set (Fraser's 1/2 existence bound is known); sharp 1/2 dimension bound for locally Lipschitz pair-sum-to-product maps; proper closed subfields have dimension at most 1/2
problems.verification: Exact symbolic argument and finite polynomial checks of up to 64 elements; dimension-one existence is not established
problems.priority: watch; investigate full-dimensional simultaneous algebraic independence

problems.title: Coprime permutations with squarefree sums
problems.question: For every n, is there a permutation sigma of [n] such that gcd(i,sigma(i))=1 and i+sigma(i) is squarefree for every i?
problems.novelty: resolved by the classical Bertrand prime-reflection construction; not an open problem
problems.result: For every n, a permutation with prime pair sums exists by recursive reflection; primality automatically implies coprimality and squarefree sums
problems.verification: Complete elementary proof; the prime-sum reflection construction is classical (Greenfield–Greenfield 1998)
problems.priority: archival known result; no unresolved prize attached to the original question

problems.title: Rank of a randomly thinned coprimality matrix
problems.question: When each integer of [n] is retained independently with probability p, does the F_2 rank of the induced coprimality matrix divided by n converge, for every fixed 0<p<1?
problems.novelty: unverified; full-matrix rank classical, random principal-submatrix limit needs a targeted specialist comparison
problems.result: Known exact full rank equals the squarefree count; bounded-differences concentration and an expected-rank radical-occupancy upper bound are proved
problems.verification: Exact binary Gaussian elimination for finite Bernoulli subsets with fixed seeds; simulations do not prove convergence
problems.priority: determine existence and possible form of the normalized mean-rank limit

problems.title: Prime-Hamming cube colorings at dyadic dimensions
problems.question: If H_n joins binary n-vectors at prime Hamming distance, is chi(H_{2^k})=2^{k+1} for every k>=2?
problems.novelty: high overlap risk: hypercube distance colorings; first-order asymptotics already follow from established coding theory
problems.result: Proved 2n-3<=chi(H_n)<=2^(1+ceil(log2 n)) for n>=5, with chi(H_4)=8 and chi(H_8)=16; the first-order asymptotic is known
problems.verification: Algebraic coloring and clique construction, independent-set/sphere-packing proof at n=8; finite verifier supplied
